narrative.overview: A black editorial collection in which original artwork carries visual authority. Yellow is a full-page color field as well as an action color. Typography moves between exceptionally large, light display lettering and a readable restrained prose voice.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized original plates and open captions.
Contrasting black and yellow page-scale fields.
Native vertical reading with separate complete essay destinations.
dos: Do preserve complete artwork lettering and independent textual captions.
Do make reading and final contact reachable through native scroll and links.
Do label representative illustrations and thought experiments honestly.
donts: Don’t import client logos, ratings, commercial claims or agency identity.
Don’t turn essays into repeated boxed modal cards.
